app_integration.note: The app's ElevenLabs pipeline uses its own reese_voice_id secret. Set it once to the approved Reese voice and do not change it. The built-in Sulafat voice is the canonical voice for content generated with the built-in speech tool. Do not clone a voice into another provider without confirming the voice owner's permission.

rules: Use Sulafat for every Reese Reviews voiceover, live ad, and review.
Do not switch voices between videos or between scenes in the same video.
Reuse the exact style strings in style_map so the delivery stays consistent.
Regenerate the full passage instead of patching a few words with a different voice.
Keep the reference audio in this folder for auditioning, QA, and future voice matching.
